execution.meaning: Previously quarantined source-equivalent R7 atomic-store model reproduced under valid SHA-only bootstrap and is de-quarantined as model evidence only.

Separates stock process-memory/fresh-ID task behavior from an application-level persistent create-or-get/redrive model and demonstrates that attempt generation does not itself make external effects exactly once.

rmcp.finding: Stock TaskManager is Arc<Mutex<HashMap<...>>> process memory, spawn generates a new UUIDv4 and then tokio::spawn, and the inspected released task manager has no caller-stable create-or-get/TaskStore seam. Custom ServerHandler task methods remain possible, so this is not generalized to impossibility of persistent custom servers.

openhands.repo_pin_correction: The SHA belongs to OpenHands/software-agent-sdk, not OpenHands/OpenHands. The exact commit is the v1.44.1 release commit.
openhands.r7_validation: Exact source confirms append_event appends before HEAD assignment; autosave/deferred dirty flush semantics; LocalConversation default callback appends/advances HEAD before last_user_message_id; default persistent store is LocalFileStore; LocalFileStore string writes use atomic_write_text(temp + file fsync + os.replace); FileStore contract does not require atomic replace; atomic_write_text does not parent-directory fsync. Therefore R7 must either require an explicit atomic one-shot snapshot capability or fail closed for generic custom stores, and full power-loss durability is not proven.

acceptance.reason: Persistent custom rmcp task execution still leaves resident server/storage plus restart-redrive and effect-fencing work; OpenHands R7 is not an applied/runtime-tested upstream patch and generic FileStore atomicity is not guaranteed.

termination.exact_continuation: Use the corrected OpenHands/software-agent-sdk@9d143aac pin. Build and source-check an exact R7 patch/test candidate that performs pure validation, off-object final snapshot construction, a guarded one-shot atomic BASE_STATE replacement only when the backend explicitly supports it, silent in-memory bookkeeping sync, then marker cleanup; fail closed for non-atomic custom FileStore and test navigation/fork, generation/digest conflict, marker-before-event, event-before-base-save, and base-save-before-cleanup. In rmcp-v3.1.4, identify the minimal custom ServerHandler/router path for server-minted RequestState identity -> persistent create-or-get -> restart redrive without bypassing current policy/validation, and keep downstream effect idempotency/fencing as a separate requirement.
